summary: Iteration 11: tested the Residential Cleaning booking form, frequency pricing, recurring payments and the admin side. Backend: new suite test_iter11_residential_recurring.py passes 11/11 (pricing example 222.28 with the weekly 15% line, one-off no discount, fortnightly/monthly, factors, EoT unchanged, 409 without auto-charge consent, checkout with customer_creation=always, cron 401/ok/duplicate, off-session charge success + failing card -> payment_failed + customer/owner emails, next_date advances, far plans untouched, admin plan status owner-only). Regression: iter9 + iter10 pass 30/30. Real end-to-end: booked a weekly clean, paid Stripe test checkout with 4242, the success page confirmed it, start_plan created an active plan (next_date +7 days, saved customer + payment_method), the booking got recurring_plan_id, then the cron charged the REAL saved card off-session (child booking confirmed/paid, payment_transactions kind recurring). Frontend desktop: /quote Residential -> /residential-cleaning/book redirect works, every step gates res-next-btn correctly, the 5 core services are pre-ticked and 'Included', the per-item counters work, 'other' needs text, the live aside price updates (222.28 for the example), the review shows every answer + breakdown + total, the pay button needs terms + pay-terms + auto-charge (recurring only) and shows total+tip (227.28), and it redirects to Stripe. Admin booking detail Regular clean section: pause/resume/cancel all work. Settings residential panel: changing weekly to 20% and pets to 1.1 saved, persisted, changed the price (215.36) and the 'Save 20%' card text. It was restored to 15% / 1.05. Mobile 390: all 8 steps have no horizontal overflow, the stepper scrolls, and the mobile Call/Book bar is absent.

minor.issue: Cancelling or refunding the FIRST booking of a regular clean does not pause/cancel its recurring_plan. The saved card keeps getting charged for future visits unless the owner also clicks 'Cancel regular clean'.
Resume sets status active without moving next_date forward. If a plan was paused past its next_date, the next cron run creates and charges a visit for a date in the past.

If finalize_booking (or anything else) raises after the charge succeeds, next_date is not advanced. The 'booking already exists for this date' guard then returns early on every later run, so the plan is stuck forever: the customer is charged and the child booking stays pending_payment. I reproduced this with a plan missing quote_id. Advance next_date / mark the child in a finally block, or make the guard advance the date.

Child visits skip slot capacity, working days and blocked dates, so they can overbook a slot or land on a non-working/blocked day (monthly dates drift). The reference prefix is hard-coded 'SO-' instead of the tenant slug used in create_booking.
The day is clamped to 28 and the clamped date is stored, so a plan starting on the 29th-31st drifts to the 28th permanently.
The plan copies the first booking's total, so a one-time promo code discount is applied to every future visit. Price changes in Settings never reach existing plans (may be intended - please confirm).

DEFAULT_SETTINGS has no pricing.residential (it was only added by a migration script for existing companies). New signup companies get no residential config: the Settings panel is hidden, and ResidentialBooking would crash on res.frequencies if used for that tenant.

ui_bugs.issue: The customer's residential answers are not shown to staff: 'Other cleaning requests' text (input.other_request), the included services ticked (general/kitchen/...), people, last cleaned. The Property section shows the irrelevant EoT 'Condition: Well maintained'. The other_request text is also missing from the owner/customer confirmation emails, so the request is effectively lost.

integration_issues.issue: Preview requests are debounced but out-of-order responses are not ignored. Once, after clicking One-off then Weekly 900ms apart, the aside stayed at £87.00 for Weekly (the API returns 73.95). With 1.5s waits it was correct. Use an AbortController or a request-id guard.

issues: Discount lines display as '£-39.23'. Should be '-£39.23'.
The floating 'Ask our receptionist' chat button covers the right-hand price amounts in res-price-breakdown and the quote aside (e.g. £8.00 and the discount amount are hidden).
A cancelled plan still shows 'Next visit' and 'The saved card is charged automatically 2 days before each visit.' Hide or replace these when status is cancelled/paused.
For a recurring booking it does not mention the regular clean / next automatic visit date.
Adaptive pricing shows USD first with US as the default country for UK customers. Consider disabling adaptive pricing or presetting GB.

action_items: Show residential answers (other_request, included tasks, people, last cleaned, frequency) in admin BookingDetail and the owner/customer emails. Hide the EoT condition row for residential bookings
Cancel/pause the recurring plan (or prompt the owner) when the first booking is cancelled/refunded
On resume, roll next_date forward to the next future date
Make _charge_visit robust: always advance next_date / record the result even if finalize_booking fails; respect slot capacity/blocked days; use the tenant reference prefix
Add RESIDENTIAL to DEFAULT_SETTINGS['pricing'] for new tenants and guard ResidentialBooking when residential config is missing
Ignore stale quote/preview responses in ResidentialBooking
Format negative amounts as -£x.xx. Keep the chat bubble from overlapping prices on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: routes_recurring.start_plan: when the Session retrieve fails, the plan is created as needs_card with no way to attach a card later (resume is blocked). Consider a 'send card update link' flow (Stripe setup-mode Checkout).

_charge_visit: a PaymentIntent in requires_action (3DS/SCA - common for UK cards off-session) is treated as failed, but the customer isn't sent a link to authenticate. Consider emailing a payment link for requires_action.

run_recurring is sequential across all companies inside a single BackgroundTask. That's OK now, but add per-plan locking (e.g. findOneAndUpdate claiming next_date) to avoid double charges if two cron runs overlap with different X-Webhook-Ids.
Monthly next_visit clamps the day to 28 permanently.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows work; 1 data-visibility bug in admin, minor UI issues)

seed_data_creation: None kept. TEST_ bookings, plans, transactions, leads, quotes, comms, cron_runs and Stripe test customers were deleted. The residential Settings were restored to weekly 15 / pets 1.05.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest backend/tests/test_iter11_residential_recurring.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. pytest.ini addopts use xdist and the env var isn't exported by default. The cron tests insert plans directly with Stripe test PMs (pm_card_visa, pm_card_chargeCustomerFail) and need quote_id set, otherwise finalize_booking 404s. The real flow is: POST bookings (weekly + consent) -> pay the checkout URL in Playwright (#cardNumber 4242..., #billingName, #billingCountry GB, 'Enter address manually', .SubmitButton) -> /payment/success finalizes -> recurring_plans doc. Pills testids are {prefix}-{key}, calendar days are '[data-testid=quote-calendar] button:not([disabled])', and slots are quote-slot-HHMM.
